PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: holds a projector's clipboard activation mid-remap while a client's blueprint is set
PluginData.Description: Test only. When a client's blueprint arrives at a projector, holds the worker that remaps the blueprint's ids right after a rotor, piston or hinge base, until the main thread has run every SetNewBlueprint postfix. Writes remap-probe.log to the server's data folder.
